form.label: NetWatch SOC - Detection Overview
form.description: Network detections from the NetWatch engine. One event per deduplicated detection; incident_key is a correlation field derived by the forwarder, not a stored column. src_ip is the address the detector recorded, which is not always the attacker - see the README before reading it that way.

search.query: index=netwatch sourcetype=netwatch:incident $sev_tok$ | spath output=tactic path=tactics{} | mvexpand tactic | timechart span=1h count AS detections by tactic
index=netwatch sourcetype=netwatch:incident $sev_tok$ | stats count AS detections dc(incident_key) AS incidents by severity severity_rank | sort severity_rank | fields - severity_rank

panel.title: Top source hosts (address the detector recorded, not an attacker verdict)

search.query: index=netwatch sourcetype=netwatch:incident $sev_tok$ | stats dc(incident_key) AS incidents count AS detections values(threat_type) AS threat_types min(severity_rank) AS worst latest(_time) AS last_seen by src_ip src_zone | eval worst_severity=case(worst==1,"CRITICAL",worst==2,"HIGH",worst==3,"MEDIUM",worst==4,"LOW",worst==5,"INFO") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%F %T") | fields src_ip src_zone worst_severity incidents detections threat_types last_seen | sort - incidents - detections | head 10

index=netwatch sourcetype=netwatch:incident $sev_tok$ | spath output=pair path=tactic_technique{} | mvexpand pair | eval tactic=mvindex(split(pair,"|"),0), technique_id=mvindex(split(pair,"|"),1) | stats dc(incident_key) AS incidents count AS detections values(threat_type) AS detectors by tactic technique_id | sort tactic technique_id

index=netwatch sourcetype=netwatch:incident $sev_tok$ | sort - _time | head 50 | eval endpoints=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | table _time severity threat_type detector endpoints src_zone dst_zone protocol confidence description incident_key alert_id
